_doc: Forge V2 WAVE B / PIECE B1 (2026-07-18) — project-local canonical SEED of durable owner defaults that pre-fill intake. This is THIS project's own copy; the global ~/.claude/FORGE_OWNER_PROFILE.json copy is deployed in a later, separate step and is owner-write-only (never written automatically by any tool). Read via .claude/forge-bin/forge-prefs.cjs::resolve() — do not change this file's shape without updating that reader's validateEntry(). Every pref is {value, source, confidence, scope}: value is the actual default; source is the verbatim owner quote or policy filename that evidences it (never fabricated — omit a pref entirely rather than invent one); confidence is 'evidenced' (directly grounded in a real quote/policy, as every pref below is) or 'inferred' (a reasonable but not directly-quoted extrapolation — none seeded here); scope is 'global' (applies regardless of project/task type) or 'domain:<x>' (applies only when the task/project matches that domain). honesty_core.cannot_override_core:true is the untouchable invariant — no later rule/candidate may weaken it, only reinforce it (enforced by future forge-doctor wiring, not yet built in this piece). NOT YET WIRED into intake/router — that is a later piece (B4); this file + forge-prefs.cjs only resolve/read it so far.

never_auto_push.source: recurring owner rule "NIET gepusht" / "Commit or push only when the user asks"

language.source: owner writes Dutch + "ook wil ik dat de gehele app ook internationaal word" + project CLAUDE.md English-default

deep_research_first.source: "/deep-research", "start een loop van 2 uur onderzoek, stop niet eerder"

real_file_testing_for_correctness_critic.source: honesty core + "Never claim a check/test ran if it didn't"

ui_quality_default.source: web design-quality rules + repeated "fix de UI/animaties" asks (screenshot-loop + no-template-look + tasteful motion for web/full-stack)

outreach_draft_only.source: per-domain principles "outreach drafted-only unless owner approves"
